role: Declares the block ray walk (World.func_147447_a and World.rayTraceBlocks) and the MovingObjectPosition block form rt_mop it returns, plus raytrace_block_bounds.

structs.name: rt_mop
structs.java: MovingObjectPosition of type BLOCK: blockX/Y/Z, sideHit and hitVec; type RT_MISS marks the uncollidable stop returnLastUncollidableBlock hands back

notes: Header only; implementation in raytrace.c. Its opening comment names BlockTorch as the only bounds override, which is out of date (the .c also shapes slabs, doors, buttons, fences and walls).
